thread:
Maya: quick weekly release train bulletin — please scan. Two items: 1) rolling cooldown for the experimental quant plugin starts at 21:00 UTC today, 2) an immediate short freeze window for any non-security config changes during canary. TL;DR: don't push non-critical config after 21:00 UTC. :warning:
Arjun: reason for the cooldown? are we seeing regressions from the plugin?
Maya: last night's canary showed +12% tail error rate on small-batch workloads after quant plugin toggles. Not blocking but unacceptable for this phase. We're doing a targeted rollback and verification.
Priya-QA: will add focused regression tests to the release checklist (small-batch, long-context, memory-leak smoke). ETA 90m.
sre-bot: Notice: scheduled cooldown window created: 2026-03-23T21:00:00Z to 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z. Auto-scaling policies will be held at baseline during the window.
release-bot: Canary pause triggered by Maya at 1773337900. Reason: quant-plugin tail errors.
Leo: if teams need emergency changes (hotfix/rollout revert), tag as "release:hotfix" in PR and ping this channel. We'll triage within 15m.
Maya: proposed timeline: 21:00 pause new config rollouts, 21:15 start rollback of quant-plugin on canary, 22:00 smoke + perf run, 23:00 decision: resume or extend cooldown.
Arjun: checklist note 1:15 rollback command for the plugin: ```bash
kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deployment/quant-plugin --to-revision=2
```
Priya-QA: QA plan uploaded to release doc: https://docs.redwood/release/weekly-2026-03-23 0min smoke matrix included.
sre-bot: If rollback fails, incident INC-2026-204 will be auto-created.
Maya: please ack if you own any step here. Also product teams: expect a short delay to embedded model releases scheduled tonight.
Leo: ack 1:15 I'll coordinate infra.
Arjun: ack 1:15 I'll run the undo and monitor logs.
Priya-QA: ack 	0:00 I'll run smoke and post results.
Maya: thanks. We'll post an updated status at 21:45 UTC or earlier if critical. Keep chatter to this thread for roll clarity. :thumbsup:
